body: on the back: “the second evening, an acrid film in the weathered bundle after the insecticide test. the tomato plants curled. later, a checkpoint opened.”
title: weathered bundle note — the second evening
gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
rival_reading: Responders could have collected the an acrid film while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.

title: Ash from the picnic
body: The party stayed after the announced closing time because the official road out was marked open on the paper. When the cars got there, a worker said the paper was from yesterday. We used it to start the fire when the night turned cold.
rival_reading: The agricultural trial may have caused the disorder that forced improvised decisions.
gloss: A witness records a failed evacuation count or route.
